title: Pi USB Boot
subtitle: Connect a supported Raspberry Pi and write its storage. USB boot tools and Raspberry Pi Imager are included.
device.waiting: Waiting for a supported board in USB boot mode.
device.help: Prepare your board for USB boot
device.prepare.cm: Compute Module: set the carrier's nRPIBOOT / EMMC-DISABLE jumper, connect its USB data port to this computer, then power on.
device.prepare.pi5: Pi 5 / 500 / 500+: disconnect power, hold the power button, then connect USB-C to this computer. Pi 500 first needs up-to-date keyboard firmware.
device.prepare.pi4: Pi 4B / 400: RPIBOOT must be configured first. Use your configured boot GPIO and a USB-C data connection.
device.prepare.older: Other supported boards: follow the board's RPIBOOT setup and use its USB OTG data port. A power-only cable will not work.
rpiboot.found: USB boot tools and Raspberry Pi Imager are ready.
rpiboot.missing: The application package is incomplete. Download and reinstall the latest release.
mode.waiting: Selected automatically when a board is detected.
boot.waiting: Waiting to check the included boot files.
boot.help: The application package is incomplete. Download and reinstall the latest release.
disks.waiting: Boot files transferred. Waiting up to 45 seconds for a new USB disk…
log.title: Log
result.transferred: rpiboot finished transferring boot files. Waiting for a new USB disk; storage is not confirmed yet.
result.disk-found: New USB disk detected: {device}. Verify that it is your Raspberry Pi's storage before writing in Imager.
result.disk-timeout: Boot files transferred, but no new USB disk was detected within 45 seconds. Check the board's power and boot output before trying again.
error.rpiboot-missing: The bundled USB boot tool is missing. Reinstall the application.
error.device-missing: No supported board was found in USB boot mode. Check its boot setup and USB data connection.
error.multiple-devices: Connect only one board in USB boot mode at a time.
error.legacy-boot-files-missing: The SD / eMMC boot files for this board are missing or incomplete.
error.modern-boot-files-missing: The boot files for this board's storage mode are missing or incomplete.
error.pcie-unsupported: This app uses the board's standard boot files. Overriding PCIe is not supported.
error.busy: A USB boot operation is already running. Wait for it to finish.
error.imager-missing: The bundled Raspberry Pi Imager could not be opened. Reinstall the application.
error.package-missing: The application resources are missing. Reinstall the application.
